item.title: 🗂️ Work across repositories or separate worktrees from one …
item.author: Visual Studio Code (@vscode.dev)
item.description:
🗂️ Work across repositories or separate worktrees from one agent session.

Each chat can use its own folder or worktree, with its own terminal, changes, tasks, and pull request.

Enable ⚙️ chat agentHost copilotAgent multiRoot in your user settings.json
